title: Custom Dock Text
shortDescription: Put your own text on the Dock: a reminder, a goal, a quote, anything. Shown in full, with an optional icon.
description:
Custom Dock Text puts your own text on the Command Palette Dock: a reminder for the day, a goal, a quote, anything you want to keep in view.

- Any text up to 80 characters, shown in full. The Dock normally cuts labels off after a few words, so this band asks for room to fit the whole text.
- An optional icon from 43 Windows Fluent icons, in the same style as the Dock's built-in widgets, picked from a list that shows each icon.
- Click the text on the Dock, or run "Set Dock text" from Command Palette, to change it.
- The text is saved and comes back after restarts.
- No network access, no accounts, no telemetry.

After installing, right-click the Dock, choose Edit and add the Custom Dock Text band.
